admission.justification: A class setup that fails after the world is built would otherwise leave a scratch coordination root, two repositories and their worktrees behind for the rest of the session; registering the existing close first removes that scratch tree when the setup fails.

applicability: The two sweep classes that build an `EntryPointWorld` in their class setup.
conditions: The existing `close` operation is registered with `addClassCleanup` before `build()` can fail.
exclusions: The world's own build, sweep and close behavior is unchanged.

evidence: host-sweep-module: 16 passed; no ambient reset or product shutdown change.

statement: The sweep fixture uses its existing close operation even when class setup fails.
